description.en: Accessible and customizable UI components built using Base UI primitives.
description.zh: 依托 Base UI 底层原语构建的高可访问性、自由定制的现代组件库。

content.en: Re UI leverages the latest Base UI headless primitives to craft accessible, highly customisable components styled with modern Tailwind CSS. It focuses on accessible keyboard loops, robust popover positioning, and clean, developer-friendly composition APIs.
content.zh: Re UI 借助最新一代 Base UI 无样式底层原语，打造出兼顾严苛无障碍标准与现代 Tailwind CSS 审美的 React 组件库。其组件严格遵循 W3C 键盘操作逻辑，定位浮层稳定，代码组合方式符合人体工学，易于融入各类设计体系。
